EmailTemplate.description: Template for sending followup to the Partner Email error that was sent to 14,500 community users
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Error Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Oooops - That was Embarrassing....
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},you received an email this morning about joining our Partner Community, which was NOT intended for you. Our other business, the Mexinsurance®, has an overly eager project team of geniuses that unfortunately made a terrible mistake. Not only did the email go to the wrong people, but it was not even the right email template. I take full responsiblity for working them too hard and not enforcing proper change controls.
Please dont mark the emails as spam. I promise it wont happen again.
If you or someone you know is interested in working with Mexinsurance® to provide the highest quality insurance for Mexico, like an insurance agency or company, send them here!
-- Respectfully,
Charles CEO Mexinsurance®
